title: The Weather Event
description: One goose lands in the Snazzie FM parking lot. Ronnie names it, declares a level four advisory, and goes to rolling coverage. Barry would like to remind everyone it is a goose.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We're interrupting the regular hour on Snazzie FM for breaking weather. Stay where you are. Do not go to the parking lot.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, it's a goose.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's a developing situation, Barry. We're getting reports. We're going live to Todd at the window.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Yeah, hi, Ronnie. So. <p:0.3> There is one goose. It's standing on the handicap spot. It hasn't moved in, like, a while.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: How big are we talking, Todd? Give the listeners a sense of scale.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Um. Goose sized.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Folks, that is a category we have not seen in this region since the spring.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Geese come every spring, Ronnie. They come every single spring.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And every spring, Barry, we are not ready. <p:0.3> The National Weather Desk has not commented, so I'm naming it myself. We're calling this one Goose Patricia.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You can't name a goose after a hurricane.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I already did. It's on the lower third now. Let's get a weather professional. Phil, you do the forecast over on the AM dial. You're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Thanks, Ronnie. So I pulled the radar, and I want everyone to stay calm. <p:0.3> The pressure's dropping. This bird has its own weather system now.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: A goose does not have a pressure system, Phil.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Tell that to the radar, Barry. There's a little spinny thing right where the goose is. <p:0.3> That's rotation. We don't love rotation.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Rotation. <p:0.3> Folks, I'm upgrading us to a Level Four Advisory. Bring in the pets. Fill the bathtub.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Fill the bathtub for a goose? Why?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You always fill the bathtub, Barry. That's just preparedness.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Ronnie? <p:0.3> Update. It looked at me. <p:0.4> Through the glass. I think it knows my name.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Stay calm, Todd. Do not establish dominance. Do not break eye contact.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Those are the opposite, Ronnie. You said both.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Hi, yes, I'm in my car in the lot, and the bird is between me and the Walgreens. <p:0.3> I have been here forty minutes. I have ice cream.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Mildred, do not abandon the vehicle. The vehicle is your shelter now.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: It's a Honda Civic, dear.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Then it's a Honda Civic that may save your life. Ration the ice cream.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Mildred, you can just walk around it. It's a goose. Walk wide and walk around.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: It hissed at the Walgreens, dear. It hissed at the whole building.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: See, that's the hiss, Barry. That's pre-event. <p:0.3> When the goose goes quiet, that's when you run.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Run from the quiet goose? Phil, every goose state is bad in your model.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Now you understand the goose, Barry.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: It's quiet now. <p:0.4> Ronnie, it just got real quiet.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: This is it. This is the eye of Patricia. <p:0.3> Phil, what's the worst case here?

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Two geese, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Two geese is not a worst case, it's a Tuesday!

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: There are six of them now.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: SIX. <p:0.3> Mildred, where did the other five come from?

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: The sky, dear. They came from the sky.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: It's making landfall! Snazzie FM is in the cone! We are IN the cone!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: They're walking in a line! <p:0.2> Single file! Toward the doors!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [sigh] Geese walk in a line! That's just how they go places!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Organized, Barry! They are ORGANIZED!

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Get to your interior goose room!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: There is no interior goose room, Phil!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Wait. <p:0.3> Wait, they stopped. <p:0.4> They're, um. <p:0.3> They're waiting at the crosswalk.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Waiting for what, Todd?

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: The light, Ronnie. <p:0.4> It turned green. They're crossing. <p:0.3> They used the crosswalk. They're gone.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: So it was geese, crossing a road. Like geese have done since the beginning of geese.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Or, Ronnie, they know our patterns now. <p:0.3> They've learned the lights.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: They've learned the lights. <p:0.3> Folks, I'm keeping us at a Level Four. Patricia has moved on, but Patricia has a sister.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You don't know that it has a sister.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: They always have a sister, Barry. <p:0.3> Keep the bathtub full. We'll be right back.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: My ice cream is soup now, dear.
